frontend/src/components/HoverTooltip.tsx: Generic hover/focus tooltip wrapper rendering animated popover content.
frontend/src/components/icons/index.tsx: Exports a set of lightweight inline SVG React icon components used throughout the app.
frontend/src/components/MotionIconButton: Animated icon button component with scale transitions and accessible focus ring.

frontend/src/components/VaultViewModeTog: Toggle component allowing switching between compact and grid vault display modes.

frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Empty placeholder file for query-related hooks.

frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Dashboard page rendering project grid, handling creation, opening, updating, and deleting projects with dialogs and confirmations.

frontend/src/pages/RarityWorkshop.tsx: Rarity workshop for adjusting trait weights with normalization, locking, and proportional updates per layer.
frontend/src/pages/Rules.tsx: Rule editor allowing users to add, update, duplicate, and delete compatibility rules between traits.
frontend/src/pages/Settings.tsx: Project settings editor managing metadata format, blockchain sync, Pinata keys, and Solana creators.
frontend/src/pages/Vault.tsx: Large React component handling NFT vault generation, filtering, sorting, worker messaging, and ZIP creation.
frontend/src/pages/Workshop.tsx: UI for managing layers and traits in a project, including add/edit/delete and rule cleanup.

project_state.json: Metadata file describing current project state, architecture notes, existing features, and pending feature requests.
